title: Compositional Mirror context group
hypothesis: A small factorized product of Mirror context coordinates can recover held-out combinations of task factors from one physical operator, at materially lower actual inference bytes than free coefficient pairs, while preserving quality and compute; independent task maps should expose the private-capacity boundary.
physical_object: One shared 6x6 physical linear operator W0
mirror_coordinate: Three factor codebooks of eight FP16/FP32 Givens angles, composed on three disjoint 2D planes at inference
logical_multiplicity: 8x8x8 = 512 categorical factor combinations generated by the product context; only a frozen subset of combinations supplies code-fit observations
controls: native Parameter Superposition random-sign unbinding over a superposed task-weight tensor
native PA16 rotational Parameter Superposition with factorized/composed angle contexts; same operation and number of coordinates as Mirror (mathematical identity control)
factorized free sine/cosine coefficient pairs per factor/category stored as FP16 and FP32
one independent angle triplet per seen task combination (no held-out composition code)
independent full task matrices as an oracle upper reference; held-out tasks receive direct calibration examples, so this is not sample-matched

task.aligned_generator: W[a,b,c] = W0 R1(alpha[a]) R2(beta[b]) R3(gamma[c]); rotations act on disjoint coordinate planes (0,1), (2,3), (4,5). Level zero is identity in each factor.
task.misaligned_generator: The root (0,0,0) uses W0; each other combination has an independently sampled full matrix unrelated to factor labels.
task.factor_inputs: The same three uint8 factor labels are supplied to every method; no task router is learned. Method-specific codebooks and all reconstruction metadata are serialized and charged.
task.primary_metric: Per-task normalized held-out MSE; report mean and max separately for seen-combination and held-out-combination sets.
task.split: For residue r=(a+3b+5c) mod 8, the selected support fraction trains on r < support_residues; remaining combinations are held out from all factorized code fitting. Validation/test examples are generated independently for every combination.

development.selection_rule: Choose the smallest support_residues in {1,2,3} that achieves mean aligned validation normalized MSE <=1e-5 and max <=1e-4 for both FP32 Mirror and FP16 coefficient control on all development seeds. Fresh results never alter this choice. If no support qualifies, record development FAIL and leave fresh unopened.
development.fit_rule: Least-squares post-fit W estimate only on selected support combinations; recover per-factor 2x2 rotation blocks by averaging their independent sine/cosine coefficients over support combinations. Mirror stores atan2 angle coordinates; coefficient controls store the two free pair coefficients. No test values enter fitting.

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
storage.codec: fixed binary record format charging magic/version, method/schema strings, names, dtypes, shapes, tensors and scalar metadata
paid_objects: all Mirror angles or coefficient codebooks
PSP superposed tensor and paid context-generation seed
storage.diagnostics: Raw tensor bytes reported separately but do not replace serialized payload size. External factor labels are supplied input to every method, not stored model state.

compute.notes: All methods have zero optimizer updates. Count support fits, code extraction, per-task table fitting and PSP construction as applicable. Runtime times the actual serialized-state inference path; no materialized transform is substituted. Workspace is an estimated peak float64 NumPy activation/temp-array footprint at batch=128 (6,144B for direct matrix paths; 14,336B for three sequential factor transforms, plus PSP sign scratch), excludes paid serialized model tensors, and is reported separately from payload bytes. The post-fit fitter supplies a common support task-map estimate bank to representation controls; PSP additionally receives all 512 generated task matrices, which is explicitly labeled as teacher-map access.

success_gate: On every fresh aligned world, factorized Mirror has held-out-combination mean normalized MSE <=1e-5 and max <=1e-4; remains within 1.10x FP16 factor-coefficient mean error with max absolute normalized-MSE difference <=1e-5; uses <=0.90x actual payload bytes of FP32 factor coefficients and <=0.75x independent full; and has no more than 2x inference latency versus FP16 factor coefficients. Mirror-specific value additionally requires a useful frontier over the matched-byte FP16 coefficient control, not merely a win over FP32 coefficients. A Mirror-specific result must also improve by >=10% actual payload bytes, or improve quality at matched bytes, over the native PA16 factorized rotational-context control.
failure_gate: Any fresh aligned quality/composition gate fails, or FP16 coefficient pairs match/beat the Mirror quality-byte-runtime point; or aligned improvement disappears on the fresh worlds. Misaligned failure bounds scope but does not alone falsify aligned composition. Exact functional/payload equivalence to the PA16 factorized rotational-context control is a development-stage Mirror-specific FAIL; fresh remains sealed because this is an algebraic control identity, not a sampled outcome.
boundaries: Synthetic post-fit representation mechanism screen; no optimizer training or capacity claim
Teacher intentionally tests commuting factorized rotations and is not evidence about naturally learned task functions
Held-out factor combinations are the primary generalization split
Independent full upper uses direct per-combination calibration examples and is explicitly sample-unmatched
PSP receives the full task-map bank to form its superposed state and is a native representation control, not a data-matched learner

amendments.change: Add native PA16 factorized rotational-context composition as the nearest direct control, using the exact same factor angles, action, precision and paid tensor state as Mirror; encode method identity with a fixed-width tag so metadata string length cannot distort actual bytes.
amendments.reason: The PA16 prior-art text explicitly includes rotational contexts and composition. Comparing only unconstrained coefficient pairs would not test whether the observed angle composition is Mirror-specific.

amendments.change: Development selected support_residues=1/8 (64 of 512 combinations), then the protocol froze this setting for fresh. Fresh seeds stayed sealed after the exact native-PA16-control failure.
amendments.reason: This was the lowest development support fraction meeting the absolute validation thresholds in all three aligned development worlds for both FP32 Mirror and the byte-matched FP16 coefficient control.

amendments.change: Report estimated peak NumPy activation/temporary-array workspace per actual path and separately disclose PSP access to all generated task matrices; workspace does not alter serialized payload or the development decision.
amendments.reason: The first development table reported zero workspace despite allocating temporary arrays, and PSP receives the complete generated matrix bank rather than only support examples.

decision: FAIL for Mirror-specific value at development because native PA16 rotational context is exactly equivalent; fresh remained unopened.
